title: The outage
task: Summarize the open issues in issues.md into summary.md
system: You are a coding agent. Use the tools to change files and run tests. Say done when the work is finished.

workspace.issues.md:
- login fails on Safari
- export drops the last row
- docs link is broken

tools.content: 3 open issues: login on Safari, export last row, broken docs link

incident.why: Every retry waits the same 200 ms, so the calls arrive every 500 ms, the same way every time, and the other clients do the same. The second wait (seq 8) is the first moment the wait should have grown and did not. The run makes 30 calls into the outage and ends as error (seq 93).
incident.hint: Read the waits in order. Does the second wait differ from the first?

notes.text: The first call is fine. The provider is busy, and that is not the harness's fault.
The first wait looks like a normal retry. The fault shows only when the second wait is the same.
The run ends as error after 30 calls. Tempting: blame the provider. The provider was down for 20 seconds; thirty calls at one fixed wait are the harness's doing.

fixes.text: Retry with exponential backoff, jitter and a cap
fixes.why: The wait grows after each failed try, and jitter spreads the clients out, so the retries stop arriving together.

fixes.text: Retry every 50 ms, so the call gets through as soon as the provider is back
fixes.why: Tempting and wrong: a faster fixed wait sends more calls into the outage, and the clients still arrive together.

fixes.text: Allow more attempts at the same wait
fixes.why: Tempting and wrong: more attempts at one wait is the same storm for longer.
